import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    k = params[8]; w = params[9]
    g = (params[0]*t + params[1]*t**2 + params[2]*np.sin(w*t) + params[3]*np.cos(w*t)
         + params[4]*t*np.exp(-k*t) + params[5]*np.log(t) + params[6]*t*np.sin(w*t) + params[7])
    return 0.547*P*np.log(P) + 0.648*t + g/P
